one_minute_value_explanation: AOF can now treat external operator comprehension and reproduction results as governed product evidence instead of informal review comments.
thirty_second_version_delta: v11.5 made provider observations readable; v11.6 records whether an operator understood and reproduced that replay, and routes weak feedback into product governance.
product_review_trigger: If an operator is confused, rejects the replay, or cannot reproduce it, the feedback must require product review and cannot be accepted as product evidence.
not_proven: This does not prove broad adoption, market value, semantic truth, provider correctness, production automation safety, credential safety, GitHub write safety, or productivity improvement.
